## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Lagos, Portugal. It starts at Medronhal-Quinta Figueiras.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> The Lagos Zoo started with a passion for animals, and in the last 20 years it has grown to a haven of conservation. There are 48 enclosures to find throughout your visit, covering everything from warm-blooded to cold, and from sky to sea.
>
> If you're an animal lover, there's enough to keep you fascinated for the whole day, from chimpan-A to chimpan-Z. You can even bring lunch and a swimming suit along – the zoo has its own picnic area and swimming pool.

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €19.12. It was rated 4.5 out of 5 from 359 ratings and 141 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
